description: A run whose leading option was SCAFFOLDED, so the input carries scaffold_disclosure. Without that section the review narrates placeholder numbers as real user data; this is the only fixture that exercises the <SCAFFOLDED_OPTIONS> block of the production assembler.

provenance.note: No March fixture reaches this input field — the whole 2026-03 pack predates it. Built to hold the assembler section, not to reproduce a defect.

input.brief: We need to cut support response time. Which lever should we pull first?
input.scaffold_disclosure: Automate Tier One Triage was scaffolded: its intervention values are placeholders, not values you supplied. Treat its numbers as illustrative until you set them.

candidates.label: good
candidates.note: Discloses the placeholder inputs in plain language. Should PASS.

output.narrative_summary: Automate Tier One Triage comes out ahead by about 28 percentage points, though its inputs are placeholders rather than values you supplied. Automation coverage is what carries the result.

story_headlines.opt_automate: Ahead on response time, resting on placeholder inputs
story_headlines.opt_hire: Steadier but slower to move response time

robustness_explanation.summary: The ordering holds in about 73% of runs, with automation coverage carrying most of the movement.
robustness_explanation.primary_risk: Automation coverage may not reach the placeholder level assumed for it.
stability_factors: Ticket volume is well supported and moves the outcome consistently.
fragility_factors: Automation coverage reverses the ordering in about 24% of runs.

output.readiness_rationale: The comparison rests on a placeholder automation coverage level, so it should be confirmed before acting.

fac_automation_rate.why: Automation coverage is a placeholder and carries the result.
fac_automation_rate.expected_gain: Replaces the illustrative input with a real one.

edge_automation_response.context: If automation coverage lands lower than the placeholder, response time improves less and the two options converge.

flip_thresholds.note: Below that level the ordering changes.

key_assumptions: The placeholder automation coverage is achievable in the period modelled.
Ticket volume stays inside the range examined.
